missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Народ' stays in the nominative case as the subject of the sentence. 'Русский' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'гостеприимный' is the predicate adjective describing the people.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location. 'Народ' is nominative as the subject of 'собрался', which agrees in masculine gender. 'Весь' means the whole crowd, and 'на площади' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Народ' is the accusative direct object of 'слушать'; as an inanimate-style collective it matches the nominative form. 'Президент' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Народа' is the genitive form after 'голос', showing whose voice it is. 'Нашего' is the agreeing masculine genitive possessive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Народу' is the dative form required by 'служить', marking the people as the one served. 'Своему' is the agreeing masculine dative possessive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Народом' is the instrumental form required by 'гордиться', expressing what one is proud of. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О народе' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic of speech. 'Своём' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: В этом регионе живут разные народы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Народы' is the nominative plural subject of 'живут', referring to distinct peoples. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в регионе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Народов' is the genitive plural after 'история', showing whose history. 'Многих' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'интересна' is the predicate.

Strategic focus: Partitive genitive. 'Народу' uses the colloquial partitive genitive form after 'сколько' to mean how many people. 'Пришло' agrees in the neuter, and 'на концерт' is the accusative direction.
